JACOBIAN ELLIPTIC FUNCTIONS AND THETA FUNCTIONS (p.572)
16.7. Principal Terms
When the elliptic function pq u is expanded in ascending powers of (u-K_\tau), where K_\tau is one of 0, K, iK', K+iK', the first term of the expansion is called the principal term and has one of the forms A, B\times(u-K_\tau), C\div(u-K_\tau). The following list gives these forms, where \times means that the divisor (u-K_\tau) has to be supplied and \div means that the factor (u-K_\tau) has to be supplied.
Columns: K_\tau= | 0 | K | iK' | K+iK'
16.7.1  sn u: 1\times | 1 | m^{-1/2}\div | m^{-1/2}
16.7.2  cn u: 1 | -m_1^{1/2}\times | -im^{-1/2}\div | -i(m_1/m)^{1/2}
16.7.3-4  dn u, cd u: 1, 1 | m_1^{1/2}, m_1^{-1/2} | im^{-1/2}, m^{-1/2}\div | im_1^{-1/2}\div, -i(mm_1)^{1/2}\div
16.7.5  sd u: 1\times | m_1^{-1/2} | im^{-1/2}\div | -i(mm_1)^{1/2}\div
16.7.6  nd u: 1 | m_1^{-1/2} | i\times | im_1^{1/2}\div
16.7.7  dc u: 1 | -1\div | m^{1/2}\times | -m^{1/2}\times
16.7.8  nc u: 1 | -m_1^{-1/2}\div | m^{1/2}\times | i(m/m_1)^{1/2}
16.7.9-12  sc u, ns u, ds u, cs u: 1, 1\times, 1\div, 1\div | -m_1^{-1/2}\div, 1, 1, m_1^{1/2} | i\times, m^{1/2}\times, im^{1/2}\times, -im^{1/2}
16.8. Change of Argument
Columns: u | -u | u+K | u-K | K-u | u+2K | u-2K | 2K-u | u+iK' | u+2iK' | u+K+iK' | u+2K+2iK'
16.8.1  sn: sn u | -sn u | cd u | -cd u | cd u | -sn u | -sn u | sn u | m^{-1/2}\mathrm{ns}\,u | \mathrm{sn}\,u | m^{-1/2}\mathrm{dc}\,u | -\mathrm{sn}\,u
16.8.2  cn: cn u | cn u | -m_1^{1/2}sd u | m_1^{1/2}sd u | m_1^{1/2}sd u | -cn u | -cn u | -cn u | -im^{-1/2}\mathrm{ds}\,u | -\mathrm{cn}\,u | -im_1^{1/2}m^{-1/2}\mathrm{nc}\,u | \mathrm{cn}\,u
16.8.3  dn: dn u | dn u | m_1^{1/2}nd u | m_1^{1/2}nd u | m_1^{1/2}nd u | dn u | dn u | dn u | im^{1/2}cs u | dn u | im^{1/2}\mathrm{sc}\,u | -\mathrm{dn}\,u
